propositions: The primary completion-verify step is dispatched without a tool_step_limit, leaving the only forced-landing primitive (shipped in agent_call.py) dormant and unreachable for this step.
Runaway tool-call cycles cause 40-70% redundant work and exhaust the step budget (240 requests) with no verdict, forcing unattested --force-close as the only exit.
The existing repetition metric (max_consecutive_repeat) detects only adjacent identical calls and is blind to k-cycles with k≥2, scoring pathological runs below healthy ones.
A windowed distinct-ratio (24-call window, trip ≤0.50, order-insensitive) reliably separates loops from legitimate breadth, firing on three instrumented pathological runs and never on healthy runs.

The shipped tool-withdrawal primitive fails on Bedrock/Anthropic (rejects protocol with tools/toolConfig omitted while history contains tool_use blocks), requiring synthetic steering (steering tool result) instead.
